items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) will not travel to London and is ruled out vs Jaguars; also Tank Dell (knee) and Jalen Pitre out.
items.why: Groin injury; not traveling with team.
items.implication: Texans RB depth elevated for London game; fantasy handcuff/backup start opportunity.
items.opportunity: Primary carries/snaps for remaining Texans RBs (e.g. Marks or others).

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts ruled out for Week 6 vs Panthers due to superficial blood clot in calf; out indefinitely until medical situation resolved, with Tanner McKee starting.
items.why: Follow-up ultrasound showed movement in small blood clot after initial discovery post-London flight; health priority.
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles pass game and Hurts fantasy managers impacted immediately; monitor treatment course.
items.opportunity: Increased opportunity for Eagles pass catchers and McKee streaming; reverse if returns sooner.

items.text: Saquon Barkley no practice again Thursday (hamstring); DeVonta Smith upgraded to limited practice.
items.why: Ongoing hamstring for Barkley; Smith progressing.
items.implication: Barkley game-time or doubtful risk high; Smith more likely active. Backups like Pierce elevated if Barkley out.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/third-down for backups if OUT; Smith routes/targets if limited but plays.

items.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice did not practice again Thursday due to hamstring.
items.implication: Risk of missing or limited; Worthy/others elevated targets.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Xavier Worthy and Chiefs WRs if out.

items.text: Lamar Jackson officially did not practice again Thursday with ankle injury.
items.why: Ankle injury from prior week; second straight absence.
items.implication: Huntley likely if out; Ravens offense downgrade; monitor Friday.
items.opportunity: Increased role for Huntley and Ravens pass catchers/RBs if Jackson inactive.

items.text: With Hurts out, Berry likes Tanner McKee as the fill-in starter.
items.why: Hurts blood clot out; McKee opportunity.
items.implication: Stream McKee; Eagles skill upside remains.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams full participant second straight day, on track to start vs Falcons; Kyle Monangai likely miss second straight.
items.implication: Bears offense upgrade; start confidence higher.
items.opportunity: Full snaps for Williams; RB opportunity if Monangai out.

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty said he is feeling great and this is the best he’s felt this season.
Matthew Berry loves Mike Evans vs Commanders secondary; ranks him WR4 for Week 6.
items.why: Washington defense buffet for pass catchers; strong matchup.
items.implication: Strong start recommendation; top WR play.

items.text: With Breece Hall week-to-week and not practicing, Levitan notes RB snaps in two full games since injury: Braelon Allen 90, Isaiah Davis 12, Kene Nwangwu 0.
items.why: Hall remains week-to-week per coach; clear snap hierarchy.
items.implication: Allen is the clear lead back/handcuff to roster/start if Hall out.

items.text: 49ers opened practice window for WR Christian Kirk (calf, IR all season).
items.implication: Potential return soon; depth chart shift for 49ers WRs.
items.opportunity: Targets if activated; monitor vs current WRs.

items.text: Berry loves Drake London vs CHI as WR6; usage bankable.
items.implication: Start with confidence in top WR tier.

items.text: Berry loves Kyren Williams vs ARI as RB5; elite recent usage vs leaky run D.
items.why: Elite usage lately; ARI run defense leaks.

items.text: Berry hates Bo Nix vs SEA as QB23; something off, not taking deep shots, playing scared.
items.why: Toughest pass D; not deep shooting, scared under pressure.
